description: Player 2 deck for spec 50 (issue #3605): p1's mirror with different one-cost loopers (State of the Game and Right-house defender instead of Wrong-House Attacker and Stratos), so both sides carry two-loop units without sharing them. Same shape otherwise: five lane units, two backrow traps, single-copy cheap spells and traps so the hand left over is all playable, and the same handicap, so both seats build their worst-case board over the first two turns and redraw to HAND_CAP by player-turn 5.
